data.name: Aun
data.gender_notes: Aun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who protects and helps others. Derived from the word ‘a’una, which means ‘to help’. The name Aun carries the meaning “protector, helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Aun usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aun represents the selfless act of helping others and protecting them from harm. It is a name that instills a sense of responsibility and compassion in the bearer.
data.etymology: Aun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “protector, helper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aun total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: عون
in_arabic.long_meaning: يعتبر اسم عون من أشهر الأسماء في اللغة العربية، يعود أصل هذا الاسم إلى العون والرّضا والمحبة، حيث يُستخدم في اللغة العربية لوصف الشخص الذي يُشعر الآخرين بالرّضا والمحبة. يُعد عون من الأسماء التي تُشير إلى الصداقة والمحبة، وتعكس الشخصية الحساسة والمحبة. في الحضارة الإسلامية، كان عون ملكًا في مصر في القرن السابع الميلادي، وكان معروفًا بصدقه وصدق نيه.

in_urdu.name: عون
in_urdu.long_meaning: عون کا نام اردو زبان میں بھی ایک مشہور نام ہے، جو عربي زبان میں سے آیا ہے۔ یہ نام عون کے معنی میں آتا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے رضا دین، معاونت اور مہربانی۔ یہ نام ایک صاف اور خوشگوار نام ہے جو کسی بھی شخص کو خوشی اور سکون دینے کے قابل ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अउन
in_hindi.long_meaning: अउन नाम हिंदी भाषा में भी एक लोकप्रिय नाम है, जो अरबी भाषा से आया है। इसका अर्थ है संतुष्टि, सहायता, और मित्रता। यह नाम एक साफ़ और सौम्य नाम है, जो किसी को भी खुशी और शांति देने के योग्य है।

in_pashto.name: عون
in_pashto.long_meaning: عون د پښتو ژبه یوړی دا پښتونو لوبړی نوم دی چی عربي ژبه څخه راغلی دی. دا نوم د عون معنی ته رسیږي، چی دا هغه چی داسلامي اصولو ته راضه وي او دا داسی هغه چی په ورځني ژوند کې داسی داسی کسانو ته مېلمه یاست چی داسلامي اصولو ته راضه وي.

in_english.name: Aun
in_english.long_meaning: The name Aun is derived from the Arabic root 'a-n-u', meaning helper, supporter, pleasure, and delight. In Islamic tradition, Aun is considered a blessed name, associated with qualities of kindness, generosity, and compassion. The name Aun is popular in many Muslim cultures, including Arabic, Urdu, and Pashto-speaking communities. It is also used in Turkish culture, where it is pronounced as 'Aun'.

data.cultural_impact: The name Aun holds a deep cultural significance in many Muslim communities. It is an expression of the societal values that prioritize helping others and taking care of one’s family and community. The Arabic language emphasizes the importance of strong relationships and community ties, and the name Aun is a representation of these values. Moreover, traditionally, in various Muslim cultures, the role of an 'aun' (uncle) extends beyond mere familial relations and into providing guidance and protection to the family, extended family, and even the larger community - making the name a symbol of love, loyalty, and responsibility.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Aun is deeply rooted in the Islamic principles of compassion, care, and service to others. In Islamic teachings, it is emphasized that helping others is an integral part of living a faithful life. Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is reported to have said, "The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer" (Bukhari); however, this does not mean that the strong one is better in all aspects, but rather in their consistent efforts to serve others. By embracing the name Aun, one is reminded of the responsibility to help, protect, and provide for others as much as they can, both materially and spiritually, emulating the Prophet’s teachings and striving to be closer to Allah.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "protector, helper" symbolizes One who protects and helps others. Derived from the word ‘a’una, which means ‘to help’.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Aun serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of protector, helper.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Aun ibn Abi al-Aswad al-Du'ali was a prominent companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Aun carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Aun was a prominent companion of the Prophet Muhammad and was known for his bravery and loyalty.
